parsed.change_summary: Added a check to limit the value of N to between 1 and 100.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code now limits the value of N to between 1 and 100. This prevents an attacker from supplying a very large value for N, which would cause the creation of a large number of child processes, leading to resource exhaustion.
parsed.behavior_changes: The program now checks if the input value for N is between 1 and 100. If not, it prints an error message and exits. This change does not affect the behavior of the program for valid input values.
